authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity with realistic stone textures and lighting. However, structural artifacts are present: strings are often fused into the body or missing entirely, appearing as solid stone ridges rather than tensioned wires. Some scrolls and tuning pegs lack crisp definition, showing slight melting or softness. These are typical AI generation flaws in rendering thin, complex structures. Despite these defects, the overall composition is coherent and aesthetically pleasing.
key_defects: Missing or fused strings on multiple violins
Fingerboards match stone color instead of ebony black
Some scrolls and pegs lack crisp definition
No bows present (though not required by atoms)
